message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese law. Facts: illegal hunting of protected wildlife (black water chicken) using prohibited methods, selling them, profit. This is violation of Wildlife Protection Law. In criminal law, "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪" (illegal hunting, buying, selling protected wildlife). Under PRC Criminal Law Article 341? Actually Article 341 of Criminal Law: "非法捕猎、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护的野生动物或者利用、买卖其制品的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So charge: "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪". Also maybe "非法买卖国家重点保护野生动物罪". The fact includes capture and sale. So single charge.

Thus answer format: [罪名]非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪<eoa>
